subject: Acceptance coda: evaluation materials, MAP and close timeline
body:
From: Emma Chen <emma.chen@arcadia-retail.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Arcadia Legal <legal@arcadia-retail.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Eval materials & MAP — last mile for proof-of-value

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency numbers look promising. Legal has one remaining ask before we sign the mutual action plan (MAP): we need a clear acceptance checklist and a short timeline for exchange of evaluation materials (testcases + prompt pack) and explicit usage constraints (retention, logging, and sandboxing).

High level asks from Arcadia:
- A two-week ephemeral access window for the prompt pack and testcases (no external redistribution).
- Confirmation that Redwood will keep audit logs for requests during the POC for 90 days and then rotate/trim as agreed.
- A brief MAP timeline with milestones so procurement can attach to the SOW.

Can you send a one-page acceptance checklist and a proposed close timeline? If you can attach the prompt sample and MAP draft we can get legal to mark up.

Best,
Emma
VP Product, Arcadia Retail

---

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Emma Chen <emma.chen@arcadia-retail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Eval materials & MAP — last mile for proof-of-value

Emma —

Appreciate the precision. Attached are two items to keep this tight: a single-page Acceptance Checklist and our draft MAP (MAP_Arcadia_v1.pdf). Key points summarized here:

1) Ephemeral access: We will grant Arcadia a two-week sandboxed access window to the prompt pack and testcases (promptpack_sample_v2.zip). The artifacts are delivered under an ephemeral license — no redistribution, no external publication. Redwood will provide a time-limited signed URL for ingestion into your sandbox.

2) Audit logs & retention: Redwood will retain request-level audit logs (timestamps, model variant, prompt id, and anonymized user identifiers) for 90 days. Logs are available via the Console exports for the duration and a one-time zipped export will be delivered at POC close. We can extend retention by agreement but that is our standard for POCs.

3) Acceptance gates (how we measure success):
   - Gate 1 (Days 0–7): Prompt pack ingested in Arcadia sandbox + smoke-run across 50 seeded testcases.
   - Gate 2 (Days 8–12): Quality validation — >85% pass rate on the seed set (as mutually defined sample metrics), no severe regressions flagged.
   - Gate 3 (Day 14): Final acceptance signoff and MAP close; Redwood hands off the final audit export.

4) Security controls: The prompt pack is delivered with PII redaction guidance and we recommend you run it in your network-isolated sandbox. We will not persist full input prompts on our hosted product beyond the audit retention window except for model tuning experiments that would require explicit consent.

Next steps:
- I am attaching the one-page Acceptance Checklist + MAP draft.
- Ben, can you attach the promptpack sample (redacted) and confirm the file checksum here?
- Karthik, please confirm we are comfortable with the 90-day audit window and the one-time zipped export.

If Arcadia signs the MAP, we can start the two-week window next Monday (Apr 12) and aim to close Apr 26.

Thanks —
Vivek
VP Partnerships, Redwood Inference

[attachment: MAP_Arcadia_v1.pdf (197 KB), promptpack_sample_v2.zip (23 MB)]

---

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Eval materials & MAP — last mile for proof-of-value

Vivek / Karthik —

I uploaded the redacted prompt pack as promptpack_sample_v2.zip and verified checksum: sha256: 3a7f1b8c9d2a4f6e9d0b5c4a6e3d8f1a2b4c9d0e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6. The archive contains: prompt_metadata.csv, five redacted prompt files (no customer PII), and a README with usage constraints.

Notes for the MAP:
- We added a clause that the prompt pack is provided under a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable evaluation license for the two-week window.
- For the audit export, ops will produce a single zipped CSV (anonymized ids) at close. No live streaming of logs to Arcadia.
- If Arcadia requests extension, procurement will signal and we can offer a single 7-day extension under the same terms.

Karthik — confirm the retention/export language is ok from a controls perspective. If yes, I’ll attach the prompt pack link in the DocuSign envelope once Emma gives the green light.

Thanks,
Ben
Sr. Account Exec, Redwood Inference

---

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 14:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Eval materials & MAP — last mile for proof-of-value

Ben / Vivek —

Confirmed. 90-day audit retention + single zipped export at close is acceptable for the POC. Security notes to call out in the MAP:
- Audit exports will remove direct identifiers and replace with pseudonymous ids.
- Prompt pack delivered with redaction report and checksum verification.
- We will not use the prompt pack for model training during the POC unless explicitly authorized in writing.

Ben — please enable the signed, time-limited URL (S3 presigned, 14-day expiry) and include the checksum in the DocuSign package. Vivek — I approve the timeline that starts Apr 12 and ends Apr 26.

Karthik Iyer
Director, Security & Controls, Redwood Inference

---

From: Emma Chen <emma.chen@arcadia-retail.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Arcadia Legal <legal@arcadia-retail.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 15:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Eval materials & MAP — last mile for proof-of-value

Vivek — thanks, this is exactly what we needed. Legal will review the MAP_Arcadia_v1.pdf and return redlines by Wednesday. We approve the proposed timeline (start Apr 12 / close Apr 26) and appreciate the clear gates. Please send the signed URL and I will confirm ingestion into our sandbox.

One small ask from procurement: can you include the HubSpot deal id in the DocuSign envelope? Our docs team uses that to reconcile the SOW.

Thanks,
Emma

[attachment stub: signed-url.txt (contains S3 presigned URL), MAP_Arcadia_v1.pdf referenced above]
